info.title: API.SH: CruiseMapper
info.description: The CruiseMapper API from API.SH: public CruiseMapper data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One cruise's day-by-day itinerary (give the cruise `id`, or a `ship` for its next cruise): every port with its country, arrival and departure times, and the departure and arrival ports. Dates are given as day and month, as the site shows them.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cruisemapper-cruise

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The cruise id (`cruise_id` from /cruisemapper/v1/ship/itineraries or /cruisemapper/v1/search).

parameters.name: ship
parameters.description: Instead of id: a ship (name, id or link); the route then answers that ship's next cruise.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A cruise line: logo, rating, its fleet (15 ships a page: year built, age, passenger capacity, IMO number, current or next cruise), the site's review and itinerary overview text, and related news. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last fleet page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cruisemapper-line

parameters.name: line
parameters.description: The cruise line: its name (e.g. `Royal Caribbean`), its CruiseMapper id (e.g. `1`) or its cruisemapper.com/cruise-lines/... link.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every scheduled cruise of one ship as the site lists it: cruise id, departure date, itinerary title (nights, round-trip or one-way), departure port and the lowest fare in USD. Pass a cruise id to /cruisemapper/v1/cruise for its day-by-day ports.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cruisemapper-ship-itineraries

parameters.name: ship
parameters.description: The ship: its name (e.g. `Wonder Of The Seas`), its CruiseMapper id (e.g. `2165`) or its cruisemapper.com/ships/... link. A name is matched with the site's ship search.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Only cruises departing on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Only cruises departing on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

get.summary: CruiseMapper ship, port and cruise line search
get.description:
Ship, port and cruise line names matching what was typed, as the site's search boxes suggest them, with their ids and links.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cruisemapper-suggest

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The text typed so far, e.g. `star`.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: What to search: `ship`, `port`, `line` or `all` (default).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Most results per type (1-200, default 50).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
